bonusWorkouts.title: KB Snatch + Turkish Get-Up Complex
bonusWorkouts.neckNotes: Turkish Get-Up: keep eyes on KB at all times. Never crane neck.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.cue: Full hip and thoracic opener. Neck neutral throughout.

exercises.name: KB Halo
exercises.cue: Light KB. Slow controlled circles around head. Mobilizes upper thoracic and shoulder girdle.

exercises.name: Hip Circle + Leg Swing
exercises.cue: Loosen hips before heavy hinge work.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
exercises.cue: Move through each position with control. Eyes on KB the whole time — this protects your neck. 3 reps each side. The original full-body strength test.

exercises.name: KB Windmill
exercises.cue: KB overhead, push hip out to side, reach free hand down leg. Eyes on KB overhead. Builds lateral strength and hip mobility. Each side.

exercises.name: KB Snatch
exercises.cue: Hinge hard, snap hips, punch KB overhead in one move. Bell should float — not muscle it. Corkscrew wrist at top. Each side. Most athletic KB movement.

exercises.name: KB Clean + Press
exercises.cue: Clean to rack, press overhead with control. Light neck load — brace hard. Each side.

exercises.name: KB Swing
exercises.cue: Finish with 3 sets of power swings at max weight. Pure hip drive.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
exercises.cue: Full hold each side. Deep hip release after heavy hinge work.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation
exercises.cue: Each side. Unwind the spine.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.cue: Full decompress.

bonusWorkouts.title: EMOM Conditioning — 30 Min
bonusWorkouts.neckNotes: Chin in on all explosive movements. Controlled landing on box.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.cue: Build pace. Last 30 sec fast.

exercises.name: Arm Cross + Shoulder Roll
exercises.cue: Open chest and upper back before EMOM.

exercises.name: Minute 1 — KB Swing
exercises.cue: 15 swings on the minute. Rest the remainder. Repeat 6x. Power every rep — this is conditioning, not grinding.

exercises.name: Minute 2 — Box Jump
exercises.cue: 10 explosive box jumps on the minute. Land soft. Step down. Rest remainder. 6x.

exercises.name: Minute 3 — Push-Up
exercises.cue: 20 push-ups on the minute. Chest to floor. Elbows 45°. 6x.

exercises.name: Minute 4 — Row Sprint
exercises.cue: 45 sec max row. Target 800+ cal/hr. Rest remainder. 6x.

exercises.name: Minute 5 — Jump Rope
exercises.cue: 45 sec max skip. Rest remainder. 6x. That's 30 minutes total.

exercises.name: Easy Walk
exercises.cue: Full HR recovery.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.cue: Deep lunge. Each side.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Stretch
exercises.cue: Glute release. Each side.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
exercises.cue: Full hold. Each side.

bonusWorkouts.title: Sandbag Bear Complex + Carries
bonusWorkouts.neckNotes: Sandbag at hip only on carries. Zero neck loading.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.cue: Slow spinal mobilization. Breathe with each movement.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.cue: Activate upper back before loading.

exercises.name: Hip Hinge Practice
exercises.cue: Prime the pattern.

exercises.name: Sandbag Power Clean
exercises.cue: Hip drive to chest. Explosive. Neck tall at catch. This is a full-body power movement.

exercises.name: Sandbag Front Squat
exercises.cue: Bag at chest. Elbows up. Deep squat. Drive hard on the way up.

exercises.name: Sandbag Push Press
exercises.cue: Dip and drive with legs, press overhead. Light load — power from legs, not shoulders. Neck neutral.

exercises.name: Sandbag Carry + Lunge
exercises.cue: Bear hug bag. Lunge 8 steps forward, 8 steps back. Weighted lunge is brutally functional.

exercises.name: TRX Row (Feet Elevated)
exercises.cue: Feet on bench. Most horizontal TRX row angle. Hardest version. Neck neutral.

exercises.name: Plank to Push-Up
exercises.cue: From forearm plank, push up to straight arm, lower back down. Core + chest + tricep combination.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
exercises.cue: Full minute each side after heavy carry work.

exercises.name: Thoracic Extension on Bench
exercises.cue: Open thoracic spine after front-loaded carries.

exercises.name: Legs-Up-The-Wall
exercises.cue: Full recovery. Breathe slow. Let everything go.

bonusWorkouts.title: Advanced Mobility — Couch Stretch + Thoracic Flow

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.cue: Slow and breathing. Full range each direction.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.cue: Full hold. Explore range today.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.cue: Back foot on bench, front knee 90°. Drive hip forward. One of the best hip flexor releases there is. Each side. 60 sec full hold.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Flow
exercises.cue: Both knees at 90°. Lean over front shin. Rotate to back shin. Explore full range. Don't rush.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.cue: On all fours. Thread one arm under body, rotating thoracic spine. Hold. Each side. Excellent T-spine rotation.

exercises.name: Quadruped T-Spine Rotation
exercises.cue: On all fours. Hand behind head. Rotate elbow toward ceiling. Each side. Builds rotational mobility critical for carries and rows.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.cue: Hold TRX for balance. Sink into deep squat. Heels down. Breathe and relax into it. Hip, ankle, and thoracic all in one.

exercises.name: Lizard Pose
exercises.cue: Front foot outside hand. Back knee down. Sink deep. Longest hold yet. Each side.

exercises.name: Band Shoulder Distraction
exercises.cue: Band anchored low. Arm through band, rotate. Shoulder joint traction and release. Each side.

exercises.name: Legs-Up-The-Wall
exercises.cue: Full 2 minutes. Breathe slow. Complete parasympathetic recovery.
